purpose: Multi-ROI visual material audit for QC7-5244 black plastic. These ROIs are diagnostic and should be manually reviewed before being used as a final fitting target.
reference_image: E:/BlenderProject/BlenderProc/塑料工件真实数据集/QC7-5244黑色/QC9-0852-正常/9K9A0793.JPG
notes: ROI boxes are in reference-image x,y,w,h pixel coordinates.
The current candidate renderer camera does not fully match the real reference camera, so this audit is a diagnostic ranking aid rather than final proof of material realism.
The center_flat_roi is the previous single ROI. Other ROIs add edge highlight, inner shadow, and micro-texture coverage.

rois.label: Center flat clean plastic
rois.reason: Checks base color and average brightness on a broad flat plastic region.

rois.label: Left inner edge highlight
rois.reason: Adds sloped/edge reflection behavior missing from a center-only ROI.

rois.label: Inner tray shadow transition
rois.reason: Checks whether material and scene calibration preserve soft shadow transitions.

rois.label: Lower textured plastic band
rois.reason: Checks fine molded texture / subtle surface grain behavior.

rois.label: Background exposure reference
rois.reason: Scene/background diagnostic only; excluded from material score.
